label: copy-phase input c, mid-sequence (recall_idx>=3, 2-5 outputs left)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99.8% of mass) on copy-phase steps whose input (the fed-back copy) is the letter c; never in the original or delimiter phase and never on the first occurrence of a token. Restricted to the middle of long copies: recall_idx >= 3 with 2-5 outputs still to go, so mostly L=8-9, t=11-13. Even under those conditions only ~22% of c inputs fire, so precision is low. The strongest activations come when the next output is k (often c k h), and out_tok in {k,c,e,t,y,w} gives higher precision (0.49) but only about half the mass. Does not fire on c in the original phase, on c early in the copy (recall_idx <= 2), or on the last output step.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: c, k, a, w, -, q; least: l, g, 2, n) and the token being output (most: k, e, c, y, w, t; least: m, x, -, i); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=9 & t=13.
